game.title: Horizon Zero Dawn
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG from Guerrilla Games in which Aloy hunts machine creatures with bows and spears, released 2017-02-28. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Growing Up and the Proving
chapters.summary: Rost's teachings, the Sawtooth and the Proving. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The main quests after the Proving, to the end of the war machine threat. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Tallnecks, Camps and Hunting Grounds
chapters.summary: Overriding Tallnecks and Cores, clearing Bandit Camps and Corrupted Zones, and the Hunting Ground trials.

chapters.title: Collectibles
chapters.summary: Vantages, Metal Flowers, Banuk Figures, Ancient Vessels, the Grazer dummies, the machine catalogue and the Shield-Weaver outfit.

chapters.title: Machines, Combat and Skills
chapters.summary: Stealth kills, tearing off parts, overrides, machine types, levels, skills and modifications.

chapters.title: The Frozen Wilds (expansion)
chapters.summary: The Cut: its quests and errands, Control Towers, new machines, Pigments, Animal Figurines, Bluegleam trades and new skills.

chapters.title: New Game+ and Ultra Hard
chapters.summary: Finishing a New Game+ run, including on Ultra Hard.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2561580)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Horizon_Zero_Dawn
Fandom (horizon.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://horizon.fandom.com/wiki/Horizon_Zero_Dawn
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs); only Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist. horizon.fandom.com answers the API, with about 58 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam has both the Complete Edition (1151640) and the Remastered version (2561580). The Steam store API shows the Remastered version on sale on its own ($49.99), while the Complete Edition is only offered through a "Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered Bundle", so app 2561580 (Remastered) was used; its schema calls the app "Glint" (an internal codename). Both apps have the same 79 achievement names (only the capitalisation of the first differs). 49 of 79 are hidden, but their names describe them, so most were sorted by name. The 7 hidden ones listed in the Frozen Wilds block (from "Took the Shaman's Path" to "Fully Improved Weapons") were put in the Frozen Wilds chapter by schema position, as were the visible spear, Dismount Strike, Machine Repair, Scorcher/Frostclaw/Fireclaw and level 60 ones, which do not name the expansion; these need checking. "Recovered a powerful weapon", "All allies joined", "Aided the defectors" and "Hunted Redmaw with Talanah" sit in the main story but may be side quests. "Cores" are named as in the data.
